pages: You already have A-215. The machine is very pleased about it.
A-215. ESTIMATED WAIT: 4 H 10 MIN. PLEASE REMAIN SEATED.
It still prints for me. Paper does not ask who you are.
YOUR APPOINTMENT IS CONFIRMED. PLEASE DO NOT QUEUE AGAIN BEFORE IT.
PLEASE TAKE A NUMBER.
NOW SERVING: A-214.
Not me. The woman at the rail is holding 214 like it might get away.
NOW SERVING: A-215. KIOSK 3: PLEASE PRESENT YOURSELF.
KIOSK 3: IDENTITY NOT FOUND. YOU DO NOT EXIST. PLEASE HOLD.
The clerk looks at the screen, then at me, then at the screen.
CLERK: The system has you as nobody. I can't serve nobody.
CLERK: But nobody can have an appointment. First free slot: ninety days. Next!
NOW SERVING: A-216. The numbers move. Mine is not one of them.

pages: Her place in the queue. Nobody in it.
The display calls A-214. Nobody stands up.
